title: Senior DevOps Engineer
descriptionHtml:
About Miovision:

At Miovision, we’re unlocking transportation networks that move you. Our vision and mission is to enable smart, fast, safe communities that simply flow, as we drive the Intelligent Mobility Revolution. Backed by the world’s most advanced traffic AI, Miovision’s innovations in traffic signal planning and operations are making it possible for cities to improve the transportation experience for drivers, cyclists and pedestrians.

Our values drive us. They’re at the core of everything we do. If they align with yours, proceed through the GREEN light!

  • All in to win: We're driven by a winning mindset, approaching every challenge with intensity, clarity, and speed.

  • One Miovision: We succeed as one team, uniting diverse talents, building on trust, and putting our shared mission before ego.

  • Be better every day: We're committed to continuous growth, staying curious, building mastery, and embracing challenges as learning opportunities.

  • Make it happen: We are proactive and results-driven, taking ownership, acting with urgency, and focusing on solutions that deliver real impact.

  • Earn the customer: We are deeply customer-centric, focused on earning our customers' partnership every day by delivering exceptional experiences that drive their success.

Position Summary:

The DevOps team is an essential part of the Software Technology Organization at Miovision, supporting the organization's infrastructure, continuous delivery requirements, overall security posture, and developer experience. Before our smart intersection technology can clear the road for emergency vehicles or optimize transit signals, our software delivery pipeline needs to run without a hitch!

We are currently looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to contribute to the development of our cloud infrastructure and platform tooling, embed security into our engineering lifecycle, and leverage AI/automation to streamline workflows. Your role will involve automating the software release and manual data reporting processes, deploying secure containerized applications, implementing robust "shift-left" security practices, increasing visibility of system health, supporting new infrastructure capabilities, ensuring reliability, scaling our product, and evaluating the latest AI practices aimed at improving overall engineering productivity. Working alongside a world-class team of engineers, you will ensure our production systems remain highly resilient, secure, and cost-optimized, giving our software teams the ultimate fast lane to innovate.

Location: Please note this is a hybrid role based out of our HQ in Kitchener, Ontario.

Objectives and Responsibilities

  1. Architecture & Delivery: Develop high-quality, secure-by-design systems from prototype to production. Evaluate design trade-offs and balance immediate execution with long-term architectural impact.

  2. CI/CD & Developer Velocity: Enable fast, secure iteration through build, test, and deployment automation (CI/CD), integrating automated security checks directly into the pipeline.

  3. System Optimization: Partner with development teams to implement improvements around scalability, security architecture, performance, availability, and cost; recommend changes to existing systems, including new technologies and refactoring opportunities.

  4. Shift-Left Security & Compliance: Automate vulnerability scanning, secret management, and compliance checks across cloud environments and container registries. Ensure continuous compliance with governance standards (SOC 2, ISO 27001) through automated reporting and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) governance.

  5. AI & Automation Leadership: Lead AI and automation initiatives within the engineering team by implementing advanced tools and platforms across the software development lifecycle to automate security workflows, drive anomaly detection, and continuously elevate DORA metrics.

  6. Collaboration & Mentorship: Partner with security and compliance teams to ensure a consistent, secure, and compliant infrastructure across Miovision. Mentor DevOps engineers, developers and others in the organization, promoting security-first best practices and knowledge sharing.

  7. Document and Knowledge Sharing: Document processes, system architectures, and security configurations to ensure knowledge is retained and disseminated.

  8. On-Call Participation: Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain system reliability and incident readiness.

Ideal Profile

  • Experience: 10+ years of overall technical/engineering experience supporting complex, mission-critical production cloud and infrastructure environments.

  • AWS Governance & Cloud Architecture: 5+ years of deep expertise driving AWS multi-account strategies, security, and compliance enforcement (AWS Organizations, Control Tower, AWS Config, CloudTrail, IAM Identity Center/SSO).

  • AWS Core Architecture & Networking: Solid grasp of foundational AWS architecture paired with hands-on operational proficiency in key managed cloud services (e.g., MSK, RDS, ElastiCache) and secure network design (VPCs, Security Groups, route tables).

  • AI-Driven Engineering: Deep practical experience using AI coding assistants and LLMs, such as Claude, AMP code, or OpenCode, to accelerate infrastructure code development, automate complex operational toil, and drive team-wide productivity.

  • Containers & GitOps: Experience building, deploying, and securing container-based applications (Kubernetes, Docker) utilizing GitOps methodologies and configuration management tools (e.g., Helm, Kustomize, ArgoCD).

  • CI/CD & Scripting: Expertise in driving continuous delivery and trunk-based development, leveraging Python and Bash to build scalable automated workflows and custom GitLab pipelines.

  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Advanced experience architecting, provisioning, and managing scalable cloud environments while building modular, reusable Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, or CloudFormation).

  • Observability & Reliability: Deep understanding of system health, logging, alerting, and distributed tracing, coupled with hands-on experience using modern observability platforms (e.g., Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

  • Data Pipelines & Storage: Experience designing highly available, secure, and cloud-native data pipelines, supported by a strong understanding of relational database design, usage, and data security (SQL, Postgres, Snowflake).

  • Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure, including participating in incident response and root-cause analysis.

  • Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills to advocate for security best practices without hindering developer velocity.

Nice-to-have Skills & Experience:

  • Experience deploying and automating security scanning and remediation workflows across the CI/CD pipeline, spanning from built-in platform features like GitLab and AWS ECR to dedicated SAST, DAST, and SCA tools (e.g., SonarQube, Trivy, Checkmarx).

  • Experience evaluating or implementing service mesh technologies (e.g., Istio, Linkerd) and advanced cloud networking architectures for microservices.

  • Knowledge of Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM) and Cloud Native Application Protection Platforms (CNAPP).

This posting is for an actual vacancy.

Your Rewards & Well-being:
We invest in our team with benefits designed for modern life and true work-life balance.

  • Comprehensive Coverage: Your well-being is covered from day one with comprehensive health benefits, 24/7 virtual healthcare access, and dedicated wellness programs.

  • Financial Future: Build for tomorrow with our RRSP/401K Matching Plan and share in the company's success through our Variable Incentive Plan.

  • Time to Recharge: Truly unplug with our unique Mio-Days and flexible vacation policy.

  • Work & Life Support: We support you with flexible work options, an internet subsidy, a remote work allowance, and enhanced leave for new parents.

Sound like your next adventure? Apply now and let's start building together!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Please indicate if you require accommodation on your application, and our team will work with you to meet your accessibility needs.

Miovision may use artificial intelligence (AI) to assist in the hiring process for tasks such as helping to identify qualified candidates, taking meeting notes, creating summaries, and streamlining administrative work. These tools are one of several factors considered in the hiring process and do not replace human judgement. We do not use AI to make any final hiring or interview decisions.

PLEASE BE AWARE OF FRAUD: Applicants interested in applying for roles at Miovision should apply directly via the details provided on our careers page. We communicate directly with applicants and will not request banking information, payment, or fees during any point of the recruitment process. We do not conduct interviews via text message. If you suspect that a third party is impersonating Miovision or requesting payment for recruitment on behalf of Miovision, please alert us via recruitment@miovision.com.

To all recruitment agencies: Miovision does not accept agency solicitation or resumes. Please do not forward resumes to our HR alias e-mail address, to any Miovision employee, or to other Miovision e-mail addresses. Miovision will not pay any fees related to unsolicited resumes.
